items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Do you think Al Jolson could outsing me? In a pig's eye. ... Don't put her out of the show 'cause Al Jolson backed up and got in the show so why can't she brown down and be in this show.

ctx.x: Entertain -- singing. He played piano and I sang. That's the type of entertainment -- singing and playing the piano. You must realize I could sing, man. You must realize I could sing. Do you think Al Jolson could outsing me? In a pig's eye. No, man, I just can't get over how - so sad in my mind for me not to take vocal lessons to reserve my voice -- preserve my voice, do you know what
I mean? I don't know why, but he was that just kind of a fella, I guess.
